description: This file defines the HungarianMatcher class, which performs assignment between predicted objects and target objects in an object detection model, utilizing cost computations based on classification, bounding box L1 error, and GIoU. It also includes a factory function to instantiate the matcher with specified costs.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: Computes an assignment between model predictions and ground-truth targets based on weighted costs for classification, bounding box error, and GIoU. Implements the forward method for performing the matching.

methods.name: forward(self, outputs, targets)
methods.description: Performs the assignment between predicted outputs and targets by computing cost matrices and solving the linear sum assignment problem for each batch element.

methods.name: __init__(self, cost_class: float = 1, cost_bbox: float = 1, cost_giou: float = 1)
